boundaries: No game files, settings, driver profiles, cache, processes, OS settings, or external messages changed. Only this research report written.

confidenceDefinitions.official: Direct official Valve/Steam source inspected, including official Steam API.
confidenceDefinitions.corroboratedDeveloper: Original Discord URL identified but inaccessible; two non-official archives agree on message ID/text/time. Cannot independently authenticate original.
confidenceDefinitions.primaryPlayerReport: Original author's own observation, not Valve diagnosis, controlled benchmark on user's PC, or evidence of universal applicability.
confidenceDefinitions.negativeFinding: No evidence found in named accessible scope; not proof that evidence cannot exist.

whatChangedSinceFirstPass: Resolved Rat King announcement to original Steam URL and exact Oct 2 16:59:51 EDT publication; aggregator display dates differ.
Recovered developer reply context: Oct 2 fixed-now message concerns joining matches as Rat King, not performance or camera.
Separated reported delivered gameplay hotfixes (tunnel timers, Haze interaction) from planned future performance and camera work.
Reviewed more new-map reports: persistent jitter at steady FPS, severe late-game patron/base dips, ultrawide regression, and Arc-specific Vulkan device loss.
Identified duplicated worker-profiler evidence in a larger FPS complaint thread; it must not be counted twice.
Found older laptop, VRAM, input, DLSS, and X3D renderer issues and marked them pre-update or hardware-mismatched rather than calling them fresh regressions.
OptiLock distribution listing now shows Oct 3 City Never Sleeps update, unlike the older cached material seen first pass.

Found documented config tradeoffs and the gameinfo matchmaking-warning claim in Sqooky's README, plus a March player thread retracting assumed enforcement. Current enforcement still needs installed-build validation.

Fresh depot-verified installed localization supersedes the README's older ConVars wording: the current denial token names unsupported Engine2/MaterialSystem2/NetworkSystem/Particles/RenderSystem/SceneSystem/WorldRenderer changes and Tools-mode, not ConVars. This identifies denial-message wording, not empirical enforcement coverage.

latestOfficialState.hotfixAssessment: Some client/gameplay fixes are evidenced, but no accessible official announcement or authenticated developer statement was found that a specific new-map FPS regression has been fixed. Unannounced hotfixes may exist.
releaseSensitiveBehavior: New Source 2 and renderer changes reduce confidence in inherited undocumented settings.
Official cheaper drop shadows provide enemy-tracking information; aggressive shadow/culling changes must be checked visually.
New map/HUD/neutral artwork changes scene complexity; a previous sandbox result is insufficient.
More settings now cloud-saved; verify persisted effective values after restart and do not accidentally assume a local text file is the sole authority.

modWarningProvenance.claimedDirective: Delete all mods, mod cache, or VPKs until mod authors update them.
modWarningProvenance.closestCurrentEvidence: Oct 2 Yoshi Rat King camera/mod warning, indirectly corroborated by two archives.
whatItDoesNotEstablish: No instruction to delete stock asset VPKs.
No blanket prohibition of all console or in-game configuration.
No proof of current gameinfo matchmaking enforcement.
modWarningProvenance.safeScope: For the requested mod-free baseline, inventory and quarantine only positively identified third-party add-ons/config remnants with reversible backup; preserve official VPK packages and use stock supported settings.

performanceFindings.evidence: Worker CPU time increases with dense view while main-thread time nearly unchanged; both renderers reported affected.
performanceFindings.classification: Primary measurement, unreplicated, Linux/Radeon hardware different from user's machine.
performanceFindings.action: Benchmark repeatable dense-city sightlines and late-game teamfights, using CPU/GPU busy and frame-time metrics; do not promise resolution scaling fixes CPU/scene work.

performanceFindings.issue: Steady reported FPS can coexist with visible jitter
performanceFindings.evidence: New-map player describes lateral/camera jitter despite a steady 40-60 FPS readout.
performanceFindings.classification: New-patch anecdote without hardware or confirmed root cause.
performanceFindings.action: Track frame times/stalls and note camera/network/animation behavior separately from averages.

performanceFindings.evidence: Arc Vulkan crashes are reported by multiple Intel users; earlier X3D/Radeon report preferred DX11 pacing despite faster Vulkan averages.
performanceFindings.classification: Hardware-specific observations; earlier Radeon evidence predates CNS.
performanceFindings.action: Treat DX11 as current local baseline, then compare Vulkan with its own warm-up and crash/pacing checks. Do not copy Intel-specific driver workarounds.

performanceFindings.evidence: Current Arc report found cache clears ineffective; earlier instrumented report had more opening stalls after backend/cache changes.
performanceFindings.classification: No current Valve cache-purge recommendation found.
performanceFindings.action: Keep warm caches for steady-state measurement. Cache deletion is a targeted corruption troubleshooting experiment, not automatic tuning.

performanceFindings.evidence: Pre-CNS Linux/NVIDIA report exhibits VRAM growth and transfer pressure; local Windows audit shows substantial unrelated system commit pressure.
performanceFindings.classification: Two distinct concerns; neither proves current game memory leak or causal stutter.
performanceFindings.action: Measure session length, VRAM/RAM/commit and background workload during A/B; avoid attributing memory usage alone to FPS regression.

supportedConfigApproach.recommendation: Start with current built-in graphics/settings UI and stock camera values; use effective cvars only after installed-build validation.
supportedConfigApproach.reason: Official patch promotes settings preview/reset behavior; current warning points to camera/mod interactions.

supportedConfigApproach.recommendation: Preserve decals, hero/trooper visibility, blast vent effects, Doorman ultimate indicators, and readable in-world text during optimization.
supportedConfigApproach.reason: Config author's FAQ itself lists these gameplay failures under aggressive overrides; visual pass must accompany performance measurement.

supportedConfigApproach.recommendation: Keep renderer choice and scaling/graphics groups as benchmark candidates, not asserted universal winners.
supportedConfigApproach.reason: Reports differ by architecture and bottleneck. User's AMD 1080p hardware is not an NVIDIA DLSS or Intel Arc machine.

supportedConfigApproach.recommendation: Reject or isolate gameinfo overrides that rely on protected cvars or an undocumented bypass.
supportedConfigApproach.reason: Fresh installed denial wording names unsupported engine/render sections and Tools-mode, not ConVars. Avoid those engine-section rewrites; operational availability, visual correctness and matchmaking eligibility still require current-build validation.

negativeFindings.scope: Official Steam announcements, current forum changelog and date-filtered public developer archives
negativeFindings.finding: No published current-build numerical FPS guarantee or Valve-endorsed maximum-FPS text config found.
negativeFindings.limit: Private communications and unannounced hotfixes not covered.

negativeFindings.finding: fps=0, cache=0, shader=0, vpk=0; performance=1 planned-work message; mods=3 camera-related messages; next cursor null.
negativeFindings.limit: Search is archive content, not authoritative complete Discord history.

negativeFindings.finding: No official diagnosis explaining all observed CPU/renderer/jitter regressions; no verified single magic setting.
negativeFindings.limit: Individual users' measurements may be accurate for their own system without generalizing.

negativeFindings.finding: Fresh installed localization establishes current denial wording for unsupported gameinfo engine/render sections and Tools-mode, but not complete runtime enforcement or a Valve-approved bypass.
negativeFindings.limit: A SHA1/depot-verified localization error string is official shipped message evidence; it does not prove which checks are active, which edits trigger them, or that all ConVars are forbidden.

negativeFindings.finding: This subagent did not execute cvars, launch a new match, capture FPS or apply settings.
negativeFindings.limit: The team needs local controlled measurements before any gain claim.

dateHandling.rule: Use Unix timestamps from official Steam API/developer archive when available. Treat forum relative labels and aggregator dates as approximate.
dateHandling.exclusions: Ignored later-than-cutoff wiki/update rows; did not infer October 4+ forum replies as current from relative Today labels.
dateHandling.limitation: Raw forum metadata unavailable after site challenge; did not bypass access controls.
